jobs.occupation: Masses, Loads and Vibration Engineer (all genders) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLEWe are looking for an experienced Masses, Loadsand Vibration Engineer to join our young and growing flight physics team. In this role, you will act as the interface between the flight physics andstructure teams: you will provide the mass estimations, derive the critical load cases from all relevant flight conditions, and quantify and mitigate vibrations for an unmanned, hybrid-electric VTOL transition aircraft. You will be responsible for the mass model, the design load envelopes and the vibration environment from early design through test verification, and your results directly shape structural sizing, performance predictions and the certification evidence of our aircraft. Working close to the hardware is part of the job - ground vibration tests, load testing and flight test verification rely on your hands-on involvement from planning through evaluation.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Develop and maintain a mass modelfor all aircraft parts and equipment, including derivation of the weight & balance envelope
• Define, verify and document design load envelopes (flight, ground, gust, maneuvers, landing and payload),traceable to certification bases
• Release critical load cases to a configuration-controlled database that serves as input to the structure team
• Quantify vibration sources and their propagation through structural parts, and design and test mitigation means
• Analyze and demonstrate aeroelastic stability (flutter, whirl flutter, divergence) across the envelope
• Maintain structural elastic models(stiffness and modal representations) and provide them to simulation and control design
• Plan, conduct and evaluate verification campaigns: interface load testing, ground vibration tests and flight test points

WHAT YOU BRING
• You hold an academic degree in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical course of study
• Five or more years of professional experience in loads analysis, structural dynamics or mass properties in aerospace round out your background
• Working with loads and dynamics toolchains, preferably Python, is something you're comfortable with
• A sound understanding of loads and vibration requirements in a certification context is part of your expertise
• Target-oriented self-management comes naturally to you, along with the ability to work both within a team and autonomously.
• Strong problem-solving, communication, and technical writing skills complete your profile.
• Fluent English rounds out your qualifications

The following would further strengthen your application:
• Rotorcraft or eVTOL experience, particularly with rotor-induced vibration, is a plus
• Hands-on involvement in ground vibration testing or flight test campaigns adds to your profile
• Experience with aeroelastic stability analysis, such as flutter or whirl flutter, is a valuable asset
• Familiarity with FE-based structural dynamics tools, such as Nastran, strengthens your application
• Mass properties management according to industry practice is an area you bring experience in

We invest in our expertise and therefore provide continuous career coaching, trainings and mentoring, all whilst working with top Siemens business leaders on multiple high-profile projects around the world. This is your chance to build your network within the company and become part of a truly international and innovative team.
To solve the biggest challenges of our time, we need bright minds with the ambition to make the impossible possible. Siemens is your place to thrive, challenge the status quo, make a difference and grow in a team of pioneers who share your passion for technology.
Discover more about CF A: Siemens Controlling and Finance Assurance (https://assets.new.siemens.com/siemens/assets/api/uuid:832d2c5d-e30c-4163-a1be-9fa3d67f645b/controlling-and-finance-assurance-info-for-applicants.pdf)

What part will you play?

- Identify key risks related to Siemens’s AI activities – in internal processes as well as in our products, covering technical, operational, contractual and regulatory aspects.- Support the continuous evolution of AI governance at Siemens.- Design and execute comprehensive audit programs and controls to address the identified risks.- Enhance and challenge existing audit techniques, e.g. by driving the responsible and effective use of AI in audit and lifting the potential from automation and data analytics.- Independently drive assurance objectives, define and align conclusions and recommended improvements to implement change (as necessary) in the organization.- Drive meetings with auditees and key stakeholders to present the team’s conclusions and recommended improvements.- Actively contribute to shaping the future of audit in the age of AI.- Build and maintain your network in various Siemens businesses and functions.- Conduct your audit engagements using CF A’s Agile Audit Framework.

What you need to make real what matters.

- Proven track record of career development including several years of professional experience within Siemens, or a technology company, or a respected assurance and consulting firm.- Strong academic history with a degree (Master or Ph.D.) in AI, data science, statistics, economics or related fields.- A passion for getting AI right, i.e. facilitating innovation and speed responsibly.- Deep expertise and hands-on experience with at least one of the following areas:- Developing AI solutions in different configurations (training ML models, utilizing foundation models, monitoring them in production), ideally in industrial settings, critical infrastructure or financial services.- Testing or certifying AI systems, devising AI governance, formulating technical standards for AI in industrial settings.
- Experience with AI deployments in the cloud.- Understanding of IT risk management (e.g., IAM, DR/BC) and assurance principles.- Certifications like ISACA AI Audit or IAPP AI Governance Professional are a plus.- Strong desire and drive to develop into a business or functional role after 3-5 years in audit.- Excellent communication skills to summarize and describe technical audit results for senior stakeholders.- Proficiency in English, flexibility to travel (up to 30%, incl. international travel) and embracing our hybrid working model is essential.

What we offer.

- A hybrid working model comprising 2 to 3 days of working from the office per week- Attractive remuneration package and relocation (if needed)- CF A Grow & Development program for both professional and personal growth- 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for you and your family- Find more benefits here (https://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs.html)

jobs.occupation: Front of House & Functional Service (Chef de Rang / Service Trainee) (Demichef de rang)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Chef de Rang; Senior Waiter

Stellenbeschreibung:
Job Title: Ambassador of Longevity Dining – Senior Host & Functional Service Trainee (m/f/d)

Focus: Storytelling at the Table, Nutritional Science & Green Michelin Star Hospitality

Location: Allgäu, Germany (Bavaria)

Contract: Full-Time / Trainee with Academic Certification

Tired of just carrying plates and reciting memorized daily specials?

In traditional restaurants, the front-of-house staff merely delivers food. At our resort, the service team is the voice of functional medicine and sustainable gastronomy.

Our guests visit not only for fine dining, but to optimize cellular health, sleep, metabolic resilience, and systemic calm. Your role is to bridge the kitchen and the guest: You explain why bitter herbs open the liver pathways, how spermidin triggers autophagy, and why our fermented pairings stabilize glucose levels.

Your Playground & Impact:

· Master active storytelling across our 10 clinical guest archetypes (from metabolic stress recovery to neuro-regeneration).

· Guide international guests through 100% non-alcoholic botanical pairings, explaining the biochemical function of cold-brewed extracts and live ferments at table-side.

· Join our accredited Longevity Hospitality Traineeship: Complete structured academic training with an official German university certification in Functional Nutrition & Phytotherapy alongside your floor shifts.

· Act as an essential ambassador during Michelin inspector visits, presenting verifiably sustainable and organic supply chains.

Who You Are:

· Background in upscale hotel service, fine dining (Chef de Rang, Senior Waiter), or modern gastronomy.

· Highly empathetic communicator with a passion for health, functional nutrition, and authentic guest interaction.

· Fluent in English (German is a strong plus); open to international applicants with valid residence, Schengen status, or Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte).

· Enthusiastic about learning nutritional biochemistry to elevate table-side storytelling to an art form.

What We Offer (Candidate Value Proposition):

· Academic University Certification: Official trainee certificate / module in Longevity Nutrition & Functional Food from an accredited German university partner.

· Visa & Relocation Support: Full guidance through official immigration procedures, Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte), or German work permits, plus initial on-site resort accommodation.

· Green Michelin Star Mission: Active, pioneering role in building Germany’s benchmark for Sustainable & Functional Fine Dining from day one.

· Cutting-Edge Food Lab: Access to professional vacuum blending, cold-press extraction technology, fermentation chambers, and an extensive in-house botanical garden.

How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: longevity@allgaeuresort.info
